researched_by: the council's own news releases and tourism site
policy_summary:
The most developed provision found anywhere so far, and the only one that has grown rather than shrunk. Ayr and Girvan started as a 2021 trial at GBP5 for a single night; both were made PERMANENT in 2022, the fee went to GBP10, and the stay went to three consecutive nights. Further sites at Ballantrae, Prestwick and Troon followed, some seasonal.

The fee includes waste disposal with chemical facilities, and Girvan has toilets and a washroom. Managed by the Ayrshire Roads Alliance.

Alongside the bays the council introduced no-overnight-parking signage on Ayr Esplanade and on Louisa Drive and Harbour Street in Girvan, with fixed penalties. Provision and restriction arriving together and deliberately - somewhere to go, and enforcement where you should not.
notes:
The reason given for the original scheme is worth recording: chemical toilet waste was being emptied into Girvan harbour and into public toilets, and there were 50 campervans in Girvan on one day. Provision was the answer to a pollution problem, not a tourism initiative - and it worked well enough to be made permanent and expanded twice.

Compare Pembrokeshire, where each revision made the scheme smaller. This is the opposite trajectory and the strongest single argument in the dataset that provision reduces the problem it is meant to address.
open_questions: Are the seasonal Troon and Ballantrae sites still running in 2026?
Current fee - GBP10 was the 2022 figure; the tourism page now says 'a fee per night'.

sites.name: Knockcushan Street Car Park, Girvan
sites.notes: Permanent since 2022, having started as a 2021 trial. The best-equipped site in the dataset - toilets and a washroom as well as chemical waste disposal. Fixed penalties for non-campervans using the bays.

sites.name: Blackburn Road Car Park, Ayr
sites.notes: Permanent since 2022. A councillor predicted 'carnage' and called the decision in for scrutiny; it was pushed through and made permanent the following year.

sites.name: The Vennel Car Park, Ballantrae
sites.notes: Seasonal, motorhomes only. Ran April to 30 September in 2022 and 2023; 2026 status unconfirmed.
